latestVersion.changelog:
caption-generator-by-image 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generates captions from images for video subtitle overlays, no manual typing needed.
- Simple workflow: upload JPG/PNG/WEBP/GIF (up to 200MB), tell it to generate captions, and export a ready-to-share 1080p MP4.
- Automatic backend session/token handling; guides users through seamless setup.
- Supports timeline preview, credits checking, and session state management via intuitive commands.
- All processing occurs on remote GPU servers; nothing to install locally.
- Includes clear error handling, export formats, and helpful workflow tips for creators.
